prompt:
The section sections/pricing-plans-grid.liquid renders a grid of pricing plans. It escapes every text setting it prints and every value it puts in an attribute (href, aria-label). Its {% schema %} block is wrong: setting ids do not match what the markup reads, a select default is invalid, block and preset definitions are missing, and some fields are absent. Do not change the markup. Replace only the schema JSON so it equals exactly the following, with keys and array entries in this order.

Top level:
- name "Pricing plans"
- tag "section"
- class "pricing-plans-section"
- settings, blocks, max_blocks 4, presets

Section settings, in order:
1. type text, id heading, label "Heading", default "Choose your plan"
2. type range, id columns, label "Columns", min 1, max 4, step 1, default 3

Blocks: one block type, with type "plan", name "Plan" and these settings in order:
1. text, id plan_name, label "Plan name", default "Starter"
2. text, id price, label "Price", default "$19"
3. select, id period, label "Billing period", options [{value "month", label "Month"}, {value "year", label "Year"}], default "month"
4. textarea, id features, label "Features", info "One feature per line"
5. text, id button_label, label "Button label", default "Get started"
6. url, id button_link, label "Button link"
7. checkbox, id featured, label "Highlight this plan", default false (a boolean, not a string)

Within each setting, the key order is: type, id, label, then min/max/step for range, options for select, info, and finally default.

max_blocks: 4.

presets: exactly one preset. Its name is "Pricing plans" and its blocks are three entries, each {"type":"plan"}.

There are no other keys. Change only sections/pricing-plans-grid.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
